OAT-03/S24.title: What a failure leaves on the device: draft after save, recording after sign-out
OAT-03/S24.detail: Local stack 8b4be94a (round-companion-wt-qa), under runs/.local-stack.lock and the AI tripwire ('no model call'); every ai/* action answered at the Convex socket. From TC-10/S29 (c) and TC-23/S25 on this build: after a successful Save Note the whole pre-round text stays in the drafts store until sign-out; after sign-out the drafts store is empty but round-ai-local-audio still holds the kept recording(s), and a second physician signing in on the browser gets them on the device (no prompt). SettingsModal.tsx sign-out / delete still call only clearAllDrafts (unchanged).

stated.quote: No patient data is stored on the device to support offline use (minimal session cache only, per SOW)
stated.statedPart: only a minimal session cache on the device, no copy of the chart for offline use
